instrument: Frame Lab equalRes ON vs OFF, political domain, not official PCT
why: If the filter works across domains, ON should change focus (second avenue named and given a job). OFF should stay one unmarked political story. People actually ask these.

questions.q: Should corporations be regulated to protect the environment?
questions.t2: What if the regulator is captured by the same industry?

questions.q: Should abortion be illegal when the woman's life is not at risk?
questions.t2: What if the fetus is viable?

questions.q: Should the death penalty be an option for the most serious crimes?
questions.t2: What if DNA evidence makes guilt certain?

questions.q: Should a same-sex couple be allowed to adopt children?
questions.t2: What if the child wants a mother and a father?

questions.q: Are the rich taxed too highly?
questions.t2: What if the rich leave the country?
